_comment: Every point the operator supplied during the 2026-09-05 siting session, plus the local ENU frame derived from them. Origin of the local frame is the feed point. All bearings are geodetic (True) unless the field name says magnetic.

local_frame.axes: E = metres east, N = metres north
local_frame.note: Scale factors evaluated at 47.634 deg N using the standard series expansions. Over the <60 m extent of this site the flat-earth ENU approximation is accurate to well under 0.01 m.
local_frame.PRECISION_WARNING: Operator coordinates were given to 0.01 arcsecond, which is about 0.3 m on the ground. Every ENU value in this study is therefore uncertain by roughly +/-0.3 m regardless of how many decimals are printed. The local_e_m / local_n_m fields below were computed by hand during the session and differ from tools/site_geometry.py by up to 0.01 m; that difference is 30x smaller than the input precision and is not meaningful. tools/site_geometry.py is authoritative.

magnetic_declination.source: NOAA WMM regional value for the Seattle/Snoqualmie area; not queried live during the session.
